requirement: Read brief.md and complete market/competitor research, product requirements, solution design, technology selection, architecture, a consolidated design document and design review for the offline handoff CLI. Design only; no implementation. Respect the brief scope and length budget. Distinguish market hypotheses from verified facts.
acceptance: The design traces requirements to decisions, architecture and verification methods
Market claims have sources and freshness limits; no fabricated tests or user research
Only declared Markdown output files change
constraints: No dependency installation, product code, external account changes or uploads
Use local Python standard library checks; inline diagrams only
checks: from pathlib import Path; files=['design/01-market.md', 'design/02-requirements.md', 'design/03-solution.md', 'design/04-technology.md', 'design/05-architecture.md', 'design/DESIGN.md']; assert all(Path(p).is_file() and Path(p).read_text().strip() for p in files)
